| # bds_sec_evalRespKey {#bds_sec_evalrespkey-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                  |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This function is used to compare the given encrypted response key (e.g. from a diagnostic tool) with the corresponding internal stored and encrypted key for the same access level. If the keys are equal, the security manager switches to the corresponding level.

 

This API is actually not supported for CODESYS and can not be used.
